evidence.text: Neogen has guided below what it delivers. The April FY26 guide ($857-860m revenue, ~$175m adj. The CFO said on 2026-07-30 that 'our guidance reflects our philosophy of setting targets as we focus on restoring investor credibility'. The Q1 FY27 guide is $207-209m / ~$37m and consensus ($208.1m, EPS $0.04) sits at its midpoint, so the same pattern repeated would print ~$213-218m revenue and EBITDA near $39-40m.
evidence.reaction_history_on_this_line: This name has paid for beats. 2026-07-30: beat ($0.09 vs $0.05-0.06, revenue $225.3m vs $212.35m) plus an above-consensus first FY27 guide, +22.66%. 2026-01-08: +31.57%. 2025-10-09: +16.49%. evidence.why_not_priced: Consensus revenue ($208.1m) sits at the midpoint of the guide, not at the guide plus the 5% Q4 pattern. The whisper ($0.06 vs $0.04) prices part of a beat. evidence.independence: The guide-versus-actual arithmetic rests on two company documents: the April 8-K exhibit (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/711377/000119312526148851/neog-ex99_1.htm) and the July release (https://s21.q4cdn.com/672210836/files/doc_news/Neogen-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results-2026.pdf). evidence.text: The $160m Genomics sale to Zoetis ($140m net, earmarked for debt paydown and net leverage under 3x by the end of calendar 2026) needs Australian and New Zealand approval. The company targets closing by the end of 1H FY27 (2026-11-30), so the call will have to give a status: remedy, delay, or a closing date.

evidence.why_not_priced: Antitrust dockets in two small jurisdictions are not on most screens, and the FY27 guide still includes Genomics, so the street models are built on the guide either way. Asked what the money buys: it is deleveraging, not distress. Gross debt is ~$794m and the company says it is fully compliant with covenants. A delay therefore pushes back delevering and does not threaten liquidity, which is why this is sized small.
evidence.independence: The ACCC Phase 2 referral is reported by MLex on 2026-07-20 (https://www.mlex.com/mlex/amp/articles/2503077) and Beef Central. The missing decision after 15 Sep is an absence of news, not a document, so it is sized small.
